name: Cybersecurity Strategy of Japan (September 2021)
owner: National Cybersecurity Office (NCO) / Cybersecurity Strategic Headquarters
description: Cybersecurity Strategy (Cabinet decision, September 28, 2021). Statutorily mandated national Cybersecurity Strategy of Japan drafted by the Cybersecurity Strategic Headquarters and approved by the Cabinet under Article 12 of the Basic Act on Cybersecurity (Act No. 104 of 2014).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by National Cybersecurity Office (NCO) / Cybersecurity Strategic Headquarters (cyber.go.jp) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for National Cybersecurity Office (NCO) / Cybersecurity Strategic Headquarters (cyber.go.jp).
